Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt

Participation in the concert series "Musik an der Furt"

June 7, 2025 · Old Town Ochsenfurt

The concert series "Musik an der Furt" takes place every year from the end of April to the beginning of August in the idyllic old town of Ochsenfurt. Every Saturday from 2 to 3 pm, various groups from the region provide musical entertainment, including "CMI" (director: Dr. Astrid Eitschberger), which performed on Saturday, June 7, 2025, together with the brass band Giebelstadt-Sulzdorf (director: Robert Schmitt) and the Ukrainian vocal ensemble "FAINO" (director: Viktoriia Hromova). During the performances, donations were collected for the aid project of Oxana Ruban, who works as a doctor at the front in Ukraine and tries to give wounded soldiers a chance of survival. At the same time, helpers offered Ukrainian specialties to contribute to the charity foundation "Headquarters Heart." This musical and culinary combination has proven itself since 2024 and also made the concert at the Furt a complete success.
